Description \& Requirements
  
  

Maximus is seeking a Training Specialist to join our team in Topeka, Kansas. In this role, you will help prepare employees for success by delivering engaging training, supporting new\-hire onboarding, and ensuring team members have the knowledge and skills needed to meet program and client expectations.
  
  

The ideal candidate is an engaging communicator who enjoys helping others learn, can adapt training to different learning styles, and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.
  
  

This is a hybrid\-remote position in Topeka, KS.
  
  

* This job is contingent upon contract award. \*


Why Maximus?
  
  

* Competitive Compensation \- Quarterly bonuses based on performance included!
* ️ Comprehensive Insurance Coverage \- Choose from various plans, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, and partially funded HSA. Additionally, enjoy Life insurance benefits and discounts on Auto, Home, Renter's, and Pet insurance.
* Future Planning \- Prepare for retirement with our 401K Retirement Savings plan and Company Matching.
* ️ Unlimited Time Off Package \- Enjoy UTO, Holidays, and sick leave,
* Holistic Wellness Support \- Access resources for physical, emotional, and financial wellness through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
* Recognition Platform \- Acknowledge and appreciate outstanding employee contributions.
* Tuition Reimbursement \- Invest in your ongoing education and development.
* Employee Perks and Discounts \- Additional benefits and discounts exclusively for employees.
* Maximus Wellness Program and Resources \- Access a range of wellness programs and resources tailored to your needs.
* Professional Development Opportunities\- Participate in training programs, workshops, and conferences. \- Adobe Captivate or eLearning development experience


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Create and develop training curriculum and training materials based on proven adult learning techniques.
* Create and develop training scenarios and update comprehensive training environment data resources to ensure that systems training mimics the production environment systems tools used by employees on a daily basis.
* Work extensively with business partners and SMEs to perform needs analysis, develop learning objectives and design deliverables that meet learner and stakeholder needs and organizational quality standards.
* Develop qualitative and quantitative assessment tools to measure learner requirements, competencies, and organizational quality standards.
* Teach instructional programs in accordance with training or other course requirements and organize materials to be presented.
* Develop assessments to measure and assess effectiveness of the curriculum and learner performance in the workplace, integrate results into new and existing course curriculum.
* Review, evaluate, and modify existing and proposed curriculums and recommend changes to policies and procedures as applicable.
* Develop and create training resources and maintain/update systems training environment and library of training resources to align with operational excellence.
* Responsible for adhering to established safety standards.
* Develop solutions to a variety of problems of moderate scope \& complexity.
* Contribute to the completion of organizational projects \& goals.
* Communicate on complex or sensitive issues or draft responses for supervisor or manager.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.
* Facilitate instructor\-led, virtual, and group training for new and existing employees.
* Deliver training in alignment with client requirements, program standards, and established course objectives.
* Support onboarding, training coordination, scheduling, and completion tracking.
* Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to identify training needs and support learner success.
* Evaluate learner performance and training effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Maintain accurate training records and provide training\-related reports to leadership.
* Ensure training activities follow company policies, client requirements, and applicable standards.
* Communicate training updates, learner progress, and concerns to leadership and stakeholders.
* Support training\-related projects and other duties as assigned by management.


Minimum Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field of study and 3\+ years of relevant professional experience required, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Must reside in Topeka, Kansas, or be willing and able to work onsite in Topeka, Kansas.


Preferred Skills and Qualifications
  
* Training facilitation and presentation skills
* Strong verbal and written communication
* Coaching and employee development
* Organization and time management
* Adaptability and flexibility
* Training content development
* Relationship building and collaboration
* Problem\-solving and critical thinking
* Data analysis and performance tracking
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and LMS platforms


Home Office Requirements
  
* Internet speed of 25mbps or higher required (you can test this by going to www.speedtest.net)
* Connectivity to the internet via either Wi‑Fi or Category 5 or 6 ethernet patch cable to the home router.
* Must currently and permanently reside in the Continental US.


EEO Statement
  
Maximus is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information and other legally protected characteristics.
  
Pay Transparency
  
Maximus compensation is based on various factors including but not limited to job location, a candidate's education, training, experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value analysis including seniority and merit systems, as well as internal pay alignment. Annual salary is just one component of Maximus's total compensation package. Other rewards may include short\- and long\-term incentives as well as program\-specific awards. Additionally, Maximus provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off. Compensation ranges may differ based on contract value but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience. An applicant's salary history will not be used in determining compensation. Maximus will comply with regulatory minimum wage rates and exempt salary thresholds in all instances.
  
  

Accommodations
  
Maximus provides reasonable accommodations to individuals requiring assistance during any phase of the employment process due to a disability, medical condition, or physical or mental impairment. If you require assistance at any stage of the employment process—including accessing job postings, completing assessments, or participating in interviews,—please contact People Operations at applicantaccom@maximus.com.
  
  

Minimum Salary
  
$ 50,000\.00
  
  

Maximum Salary
  
$ 60,000\.00

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
#### **About ProcessUnity**


ProcessUnity is the Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) company. Our software platforms and data services protect customers from cybersecurity threats, breaches, and outages that originate from their ever\-growing ecosystem of business partners. By combining the world’s largest third\-party risk data exchange, the leading TPRM workflow platform, and powerful artificial intelligence, ProcessUnity extends third\-party risk, procurement, and cybersecurity teams so they can cover their entire vendor portfolio. With ProcessUnity, organizations of all sizes reduce assessment work while improving quality, securing intellectual property and customer data so business operations continue to operate uninterrupted.#### **Implementation Consultant**


We're looking for a dynamic, technically apt individual to join our Customer Success team focused on consulting and configuring solutions on the ProcessUnity risk and compliance platform. The ideal candidate will have strong communication skills, creative problem solving, and the ability to juggle multiple work\-streams to support the company’s growth. In this position, you will be a member of our Customer Success team but also interface with sales, customer support, product development, and engineering teams while developing deep technical expertise in ProcessUnity’s software solutions to lead client implementations. Confident, highly self\-motivated candidates capable of coordinating multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced environment will succeed within Customer Success and the Implementation team.

  

All new Implementation Consultants undergo a structured onboarding and apprenticeship as they are educated on ProcessUnity functionality and configuration. In addition, implementation consultants are assigned a corresponding senior colleague to provide mentorship, guidance and assistance. As your skillset develops, Implementation Consultants are assigned client\-facing responsibilities and expand their role as a member of the Services team.


Please note that this is a remote role, but you must be based within the United States.

##### **What You’ll Do:**

* Configure ProcessUnity’s software applications for customers using an enablement/teaching approach
* Lead, manage and coordinate multiple customer implementations simultaneously
* Gather customer requirements and translate to ProcessUnity’s capabilities
* Develop and deliver deep product and technical expertise to ProcessUnity customers
* Participate in knowledge transfer sessions, product training and other strategic initiatives as needed
* Provide a mixture of remote and onsite customer implementation workshops
* Consult with customers on system configuration based on product and industry best practices
* Facilitate touch points and status meetings with customers in a timely and professional manner
* Contribute to the development of best practices, project standards and methodologies to improve efficiency and effectiveness of implementations and team processes/policies/procedures
* Maintain working knowledge of ProcessUnity solutions, platform features and best practices

##### **Desired Experience \& Skills:**

* BS/BA degree in a computer\-related discipline or equivalent experience (MBA/MS is a plus)
* Based in United States
* 5\+ years professional experience in client\-facing roles, with preference towards software implementation/information technology Comfort and experience with software and configuration of software
* Competency with larger volumes of data, spreadsheets, data manipulation, formula writing and CSV support
* Technical knowledge of fundamental database concepts and relational data
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Creative problem solver with focus on quality
* Project management experience; organized
* Enthusiastic self\-starting team player
* Experience with Salesforce administration is a plus

 **Salary range:** $80,000\.00\- $100,000\.00 depending on experience

  

At ProcessUnity, we not only provide a platform that ensures operational excellence, but we also foster an environment where our employees can thrive professionally. Join us and be a part of a dynamic team that values innovation, excellence, and a customer\-centric approach. ProcessUnity offers a competitive compensation package, which includes comprehensive health and dental insurance, generous paid time off and a 401k with employer match.
\-
Qualified applicants are encouraged to submit their resume along with a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and why they are the best fit for ProcessUnity.  

ProcessUnity is committed to providing an inclusive and equitable workplace where people of all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences can thrive. ProcessUnity is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.  

Learn more about us at www.processunity.com.

jobs.title: Sr Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Veradigm DORN is a cloud\-based diagnostic ordering and results network that gives EHR partners a single integration point into a growing network of 500\+ laboratory and radiology centers. Instead of building and maintaining a custom interface for every lab or imaging center, EHRs connect once to DORN and gain standardized, HL7\-based order and results connectivity across the network.


The Senior Implementation Consultant leads technical integration projects for Veradigm DORN across laboratory, radiology, and EHR partners. This role owns projects end to end, from kickoff through production certification, managing both net\-new integrations and partner transitions. The consultant also maintains lab and radiology test compendiums and supports EHR partners as they onboard and test new labs and radiology centers on the network.


Required Qualifications:


* 5\+ years of experience in healthcare IT implementation, integration, or technical project management, ideally involving labs, radiology, or EHR systems.
* Hands\-on experience with HL7 messaging (orders and results) and API\-based integrations.
* Working knowledge of laboratory or radiology order/results workflows, including test compendiums and result mapping.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation projects with competing timelines and stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience leading meetings with external partners and technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Comfortable working directly with EHR vendors, lab/radiology partners, and internal engineering, product, and support teams.

Preferred Qualifications:


* Prior experience with Veradigm products (DORN, Veradigm EHR, Practice Fusion) or comparable diagnostic connectivity platforms.
* Familiarity with reference lab operations (e.g., LabCorp, Quest Diagnostics) or radiology/imaging center workflows.
* Experience managing EHR\-to\-lab or EHR\-to\-radiology integration migrations or platform transitions.
* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management certification.

What You'll Contribute:


* Manage the full lifecycle of net\-new and transition integration projects for DORN lab, radiology, and EHR partners, from kickoff and technical scoping through QA certification and go\-live.
* Lead technical design discussions with partners to translate clinical and operational requirements into a working DORN integration, using API and HL7 (order and results messaging) standards.
* Build and maintain project schedules, milestones, and status reporting; run kickoff calls, weekly status meetings, and risk/issue tracking for each active engagement.
* Own and maintain lab and radiology compendiums, ensuring test/order codes, result formats, and mappings stay accurate and current for each connected lab or radiology center.
* Support EHR partners in onboarding and testing new labs and radiology centers via DORN, including test plan execution, QA demo review, and production certification.
* Coordinate with laboratory and radiology partners (e.g., LabCorp, Quest Diagnostics, regional and hospital labs, imaging centers) on connectivity requirements, transaction fee structures, and go\-live readiness.
* Troubleshoot integration issues during implementation and early production, partnering with engineering and support teams to resolve order/result transmission problems.
* Identify and escalate project risks, scope changes, and delays; manage change orders in coordination with account and product teams.
* Provide implementation\-led support during the post\-certification stabilization period, and hand off cleanly to ongoing support once a partner reaches steady state.
* Document integration decisions, configurations, and lessons learned to improve repeatability across future DORN implementations.

**Compensation Range:**

$69,852\-$97,094
Compensation for this job is subject to market conditions, geographic considerations, the candidate’s unique skills and experience, state and local laws, and budget. Our commitment to pay transparency is a testament to our dedication to creating a fair, equitable, and inclusive workplace. By continuously analyzing market trends, staying abreast of changes in state laws, and making budgetary adjustments accordingly, we strive to ensure that our compensation practices reflect the value we place on our associates’ unique contributions and support their professional growth.  



  

**Enhancing Lives and Building Careers**

  

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work and to further their professional development. Together, we are In the Network. Interested in learning more?  



  

Take a look at our Culture , Benefits , Early Talent Program , and Additional Openings .  



  

Visa Sponsorship is not offered for this position.  



  

At Veradigm, our greatest strength comes from bringing together talented people with diverse perspectives to support the needs of healthcare providers, life science companies, health plans, and the patients they serve. The Veradigm Network is a dynamic, open community of solutions, external partners, and cutting\-edge artificial intelligence technologies that provide advanced insights, technology, and data\-driven solutions. Veradigm offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including holidays, vacation, medical, dental, and vision insurance, company paid life insurance and retirement savings.  



  

Veradigm’s policy is to provide equal employment opportunity and affirmative action in all of its employment practices without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, individuals with disabilities, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. Applicants for North American based positions with Veradigm must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Verification of employment eligibility will be required as a condition of hire. Veradigm is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse and inclusive workforce.

jobs.title: EHR Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:
**POSITION TITLE:** EHR Support Specialist

**FLSA CLASSIFICATION:** Non\-Exempt

**POSITION OVERVIEW:** The Electronic Health Record Support Specialist assists with accurate, efficient, and compliant use of the agency electronic health record (EHR) system. The position maintains EHR information and documentation tools, monitors documentation workflows and quality, provides routine user support and training, and assists with system testing, reporting, and implementation activities.


**ESSENTIAL POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Core Job Functions \& Essential Tasks**

* Enters, updates, and maintains information and other assigned data within the EHR.
* Builds and maintains electronic forms, templates, assessments, and documentation tools within the EHR.
* Updates forms and workflows to reflect regulatory, payer, agency, and operational changes; documents changes and tests functionality before deployment.
* Monitors documentation workflows for completeness, missing information, and required documentation.

**Administrative \& Operational Support**

* Generates routine reports and import/export files to assist with data, quality, and compliance initiatives.
* Maintains EHR documentation manuals, training resources, records, and other system documentation.
* Supports user\-account maintenance and password resets within assigned access and security protocols.
* Assists with maintaining accurate information and documentation practices consistent with agency policy, payer requirements, CARF standards, HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, and applicable regulations.

**Requests, Service \& Responsiveness**

* Serves as the first point of contact for EHR questions and assists users with navigating system issues.
* Troubleshoots basic EHR issues and appropriately escalates technical, privacy, or security concerns.
* Provides introductory EHR training as well as training on workflows and documentation standards.
* Develops quick\-reference guides, job aids, and training materials for users of varying computer proficiency.

**Projects \& Special Assignments**

* Assists with testing new EHR functionality, forms, templates, and workflows before implementation.
* Participates in EHR implementation projects and supports deployment of new features and processes.
* Collaborates with departments to improve documentation efficiency and reinforce agency standards.

**Departmental \& Organizational Support**

* Notifies staff of documentation deficiencies and supports timely follow\-up and correction processes.
* Attends meetings related to EHR use, data and documentation, workflows, and system implementation.
* Supports MHA’s mission through accurate records, responsive service, confidentiality, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Complies with HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, payer, and regulatory requirements.
* Completes other duties and special assignments as requested by the EHR Administrator.

**ORGANIZATION STANDARDS:**

**Professionalism and Communication**


Demonstrates clear, respectful, and professional communication in both verbal and written interactions, with a focus on collaboration and solution\-oriented dialogue. Shares information responsibly and addresses concerns constructively while maintaining a positive, professional demeanor—even in challenging situations.

**Time \& Priority Management**


Effectively manages workload by prioritizing tasks, planning proactively, and addressing challenges to meet deadlines and responsibilities. Maintains a solution\-focused approach and professional composure while balancing competing priorities.

**Reliability \& Accountability \& Ownership**


Demonstrates dependability by consistently meeting commitments, deadlines, and responsibilities while taking ownership of work and outcomes. Acts with integrity, follows through on obligations, and addresses mistakes proactively to support a culture of accountability and trust.

**Adaptability and Change Agility**


Demonstrates adaptability by embracing new processes, priorities, and organizational changes with resilience and a willingness to learn. Adjusts work approaches as needed and supports others through change with a constructive, solution\-focused mindset.

**Organizational Alignment and Mission Focus**


Demonstrates behaviors aligned with the organization’s mission, values, and professional standards while supporting goals and initiatives through actions and attitude. Consistently follows policies and ethical guidelines, maintains confidentiality, and contributes to a culture of professionalism, respect, and service.


Requirements:

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS:**

* High school diploma/GED required; relevant associate degree preferred.
* One year of administrative, healthcare, or customer\-service experience preferred.
* EHR experience preferred; Netsmart MyEvolv or behavioral health EHR experience strongly preferred.
* Basic EHR knowledge to develop electronic forms, templates, tools, and workflow configurations.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, organization, problem solving, communication, time management.
* Microsoft Office proficiency with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

**Driver Level:** Level 3 – Occasional driving for meetings, training, or non\-routine sites. License not required, reliable transportation required, legal use of transportation when driving for work purposes.

**Position Flexibility: Onsite (No Remote Work):** This is an onsite position with no regular remote work option. If role allows, limited flexibility for remote work may be granted in the event of office closures due to inclement weather; otherwise, remote work is not available.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Prolonged sitting, viewing a computer monitor, keyboarding, and use of standard office equipment.
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, lifting or carrying office up to twenty\-five (25\) pounds.
* Reliable transportation and occasional travel to meetings, training, or non\-routine sites as required.


All the above duties and responsibilities are considered essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. All job requirements listed indicate the minimum level of knowledge, skills and/or ability deemed necessary to perform the job proficiently. This job description is not to be construed as a detailed statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Employees may be required to perform any other job\-related instructions as requested by their supervisors, subject to reasonable accommodation.

jobs.title: Clinical Implementation & Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager**

About MedGEO

MedGEO is a healthcare technology company transforming how procedural care is documented, understood, and optimized at the point of care. Built by clinicians for clinicians, MedGEO combines intelligent automation, AI, and Smart Vision technology to reduce documentation burden, improve data accuracy, strengthen compliance, and provide healthcare organizations with greater visibility into the clinical, operational, and financial performance of procedural care.

Our technology works directly within operating rooms and procedural environments, helping nurses and clinicians spend less time on administrative tasks and more time focused on patients.

About the Role

MedGEO is seeking a highly motivated **Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager** to lead customer onboarding, clinical implementation, training, go\-live support, adoption, and ongoing customer success for our healthcare technology platform.

This role requires a **nursing background**, with **operating room, perioperative, surgical services, or procedural\-care experience strongly preferred**. The ideal candidate understands the realities of surgical workflows, clinical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, physician and nursing workflows, and the operational demands placed on OR teams.

You will serve as a primary point of contact for customers, helping clinical teams successfully adopt MedGEO’s technology and ensuring customers achieve meaningful clinical, operational, and financial value. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role that requires strong communication, project management, technical aptitude, and the ability to work closely with hospital teams as well as MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.

This role requires onsite travel for implementations and go\-lives, with expected travel ranging from approximately **20% to 50% of the time**, depending on customer growth, implementation schedules, go\-live activity, and business needs.

Because MedGEO is still in an early and formative stage of growth, this role also includes the opportunity to participate in the company’s long\-term upside through **early equity in the company**. We are looking for someone who wants to help build the customer success and implementation function, contribute meaningfully to the company’s growth, and share in the value they help create as MedGEO scales.

The right person will be comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment, rolling up their sleeves during implementations and go\-lives, and helping build the customer success function as MedGEO grows.

Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Implementation \& Go\-Live Support

* Lead end\-to\-end clinical implementation processes, including planning, workflow assessment, training, go\-live readiness, launch support, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Work directly with OR nurses, surgeons, perioperative leaders, hospital administrators, IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, and other customer stakeholders.
* Assess current clinical workflows and determine how MedGEO should be incorporated into existing surgical and procedural processes.
* Support implementation of MedGEO workflows related to surgical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, intraoperative resource utilization, Smart Vision, and related platform capabilities.
* Develop implementation plans, timelines, milestones, training schedules, and go\-live readiness criteria.
* Provide onsite and remote support during customer onboarding, training, go\-live, and optimization periods.
* Proactively identify implementation risks, workflow issues, adoption barriers, and customer concerns, and escalate as needed.

Customer Success \& Adoption

* Serve as a trusted clinical and operational partner for assigned customers.
* Build strong relationships with frontline clinicians, nurse managers, perioperative directors, surgeons, IT teams, supply chain, revenue cycle, and executive stakeholders.
* Monitor customer adoption, utilization, engagement, satisfaction, and workflow performance.
* Identify adoption gaps and work directly with customer teams to improve usage, training, and workflow alignment.
* Provide ongoing education and support to existing and new users.
* Communicate new MedGEO functionality, best practices, and workflow recommendations to customers.
* Help develop customer champions who can support adoption internally and serve as references for MedGEO externally.

Product Commercialization \& Voice of the Customer

* Serve as a bridge between customers and MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.
* Translate frontline clinical feedback into clear product recommendations, workflow improvements, training needs, and commercialization priorities.
* Help Product and Engineering understand how MedGEO performs in real\-world OR and procedural environments.
* Identify recurring customer pain points, workflow challenges, usability issues, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Support rollout of new product capabilities, modules, Smart Vision enhancements, analytics features, and workflow tools.
* Contribute to customer\-facing materials, training resources, workflow guides, implementation playbooks, and product adoption best practices.
* Help determine whether new product features are ready for broader customer rollout based on usability, workflow fit, customer readiness, and measurable value.

Customer Value, Expansion \& Retention

* Help customers understand and measure the clinical, operational, and financial value generated by MedGEO.
* Track improvements in documentation efficiency, utilization capture, accuracy, compliance, workflow performance, and financial outcomes.
* Support customer business reviews, ROI discussions, executive updates, and account health reporting.
* Partner with Sales and leadership to identify opportunities for renewals, upsells, expansions, and additional deployments across ORs, service lines, departments, facilities, and health\-system locations.
* Support customer retention by ensuring strong adoption, responsiveness, and demonstrated value.
* Contribute to case studies, testimonials, success stories, and reference materials.

Internal Coordination \& Tools

* Use tools such as **Jira, Slack, CRM systems, project trackers, shared documentation platforms, and other workflow tools** to manage tasks, customer updates, implementation progress, product feedback, and internal communication.
* Document customer issues, workflow needs, implementation milestones, product requests, and follow\-up items clearly and consistently.
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering through Jira or similar tools to report bugs, prioritize customer\-impacting issues, and track resolution.
* Communicate effectively with internal teams through Slack, email, meetings, and project management tools.
* Maintain accurate customer records, implementation notes, account updates, risks, and action items.

Required Qualifications

* **Registered Nurse or clinical nursing background required.**
* **Operating room, perioperative, surgical services, or procedural\-care experience strongly preferred.**
* Strong understanding of OR workflows, surgical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, physician workflows, nursing workflows, and multidisciplinary surgical teams.
* Experience working with surgeons, OR nurses, perioperative leadership, anesthesia teams, surgical technologists, hospital administrators, IT, supply chain, or revenue cycle teams.
* Experience in clinical implementation, customer success, healthcare technology, clinical education, nursing leadership, informatics, medical device, or healthcare operations.
* Strong technical aptitude and comfort learning healthcare software platforms.
* Ability to train clinical users and explain technology in a clear, practical, workflow\-focused way.
* Familiarity with tools such as **Jira, Slack, CRM systems, project management tools, and shared documentation platforms**.
* Strong project management, organizational, and follow\-through skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations, priorities, and internal stakeholders at the same time.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both frontline clinicians and executive hospital leadership.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities can evolve quickly.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately **20% to 50%** for implementations, training, go\-lives, workflow assessments, and customer optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

* CNOR certification or prior circulating OR nurse experience.
* Experience as an OR nurse manager, clinical educator, perioperative coordinator, surgical services leader, or clinical informatics specialist.
* Experience implementing healthcare technology, EHR systems, perioperative systems, medical device software, or digital workflow solutions.
* Familiarity with Epic OpTime, HST, SIS, Cerner, or other perioperative or procedural systems.
* Experience with implant\-heavy specialties such as orthopedics, spine, cardiovascular, plastics, oral surgery, or other procedural service lines.
* Experience working with hospital IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, clinical operations, or clinical informatics teams.
* Previous experience in customer success, clinical implementation, clinical solutions, or healthcare SaaS is highly valuable.

Who Will Thrive at MedGEO

The right person for this role understands the operating room because they have worked in or around one. You can walk into a procedural environment, understand what the clinical team is doing, identify where documentation or workflow gaps occur, and translate those observations into practical recommendations for customers and internal teams.

You are clinically credible, technically curious, highly organized, and comfortable communicating with everyone from frontline nurses to surgeons, administrators, engineers, and executives. You are willing to roll up your sleeves during go\-lives, solve problems in real time, and help build the customer success function as MedGEO grows.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to combine nursing experience, healthcare technology, customer leadership, implementation, and product commercialization in a high\-impact role at an early\-stage company.

Pay: $84,288\.58 \- $150,508\.82 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Please describe your operating room, perioperative, or procedural\-care experience and how you have used that background to support implementation, training, customer adoption, or workflow improvement for a healthcare technology, medical device, or clinical process.

Experience:

* Nurse management: 2 years (Required)
* Nursing: 2 years (Required)
* Healthcare management: 1 year (Preferred)
* OR: 2 years (Required)

License/Certification:

* RN License (Preferred)
* CNOR (Preferred)
* Ambulatory Care Nursing Certification (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Glendale, CA 91207

jobs.title: EHR Implementation Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Functions, Duties, Responsibilities and Position Qualifications:**

**We're not just a workplace \- we're a Great Place to Work certified employer!**


Proudly certified as a Great Place to Work, we are dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive environment. At Sonic Healthcare USA, we emphasize teamwork and innovation. Check out our job openings and advance your career with a company that values its team members!

**Position Summary**


The **EHR Implementation Analyst** plays a key role in delivering healthcare technology solutions that connect providers, laboratories, and clinical systems. This position supports the implementation, testing, and maintenance of electronic health record (EHR), laboratory information system (LIS), and related healthcare integrations to ensure the accurate and efficient exchange of clinical information.


Working closely with clients, vendors, and internal teams, this role supports interface implementations from planning through production while helping resolve technical issues and improve the overall client experience. This is an excellent opportunity for a healthcare IT professional looking to build expertise in interoperability, systems integration, and implementation project delivery.

**Location:** Dallas, TX (Remote)  

**Full\-Time \| Benefits Eligible**

**What We're Looking For**


We're seeking a collaborative and detail\-oriented professional who enjoys solving technical challenges and helping clients succeed. The ideal candidate is organized, customer\-focused, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. The successful candidate will bring:

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities.
* A customer\-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
* The ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively.
* Attention to detail and strong follow\-through.
* The ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* An interest in healthcare technology, systems integration, and interoperability.

**What You'll Do**


Implementation \& Project Support

* Support the implementation of EHR, LIS, and other healthcare system interfaces.
* Configure, test, validate, and document interface solutions.
* Partner with clients, vendors, and internal teams to gather requirements and support successful project execution.
* Monitor project milestones, communicate project status, and escalate risks or issues when needed.
* Ensure implementations are completed accurately, on schedule, and in accordance with quality standards.


Technical Support \& Troubleshooting

* Support healthcare interoperability initiatives, including HL7\-based interfaces.
* Troubleshoot interface connectivity issues, including SFTP and VPN connections.
* Provide Level II support for production interfaces and implementation\-related issues.
* Collaborate with Client Support, Help Desk, and technical teams to resolve complex system issues.
* Participate in root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts.


Documentation, Compliance \& Process Improvement

* Maintain implementation documentation, testing records, and project deliverables.
* Support compliance with HIPAA and applicable healthcare regulations.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes and workflows.
* Participate in special projects and other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**


Education

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Experience

* 1\-3 years of experience in healthcare IT, systems implementation, technical support, or a related field.
* Experience supporting healthcare applications, EHR platforms, or clinical systems preferred.


Preferred Knowledge \& Skills

* Familiarity with HL7 standards and healthcare interoperability concepts.
* Experience with interface engines, such as Corepoint, preferred.
* Understanding of laboratory information systems (LIS) and clinical workflows preferred.
* Knowledge of networking concepts, including SFTP and VPN connectivity.
* Experience gathering requirements, documenting technical solutions, and supporting implementation projects.

**Epic Training Coordinator**
=============================


**Job Description**
-------------------


**Overview**


**Epic Training Coordinator**

  

Our teams shape strategic initiatives, have passion, and work to improve health outcomes. They advance our mission and exemplify excellence, compassion, teamwork, and purpose in all that they do**.**Indiana University Health is seeking individuals who embody these values to join our Information Services team in the role of Epic Training Coordinator. This position is full\-time/hybrid and located in Indianapolis, IN.

**Summary**


Responsible for delivering high\-quality training and education on Epic Electronic Health Record (EHR) modules to end users, including clinical staff, physicians, nurses, and administrative personnel. Develops and implements comprehensive training programs to ensure that all users are proficient in using the Epic system. Collaborates with subject matter experts, application analysts, and leadership to tailor training materials, manage training sessions, and provide ongoing support post go\-live. Training Development: Develop, customize, and maintain training materials, curricula, and documentation for various Epic modules, tailored to specific user roles (e.g., physicians, nurses, administrative staff). Create e\-learning modules, user guides, job aids, and other educational resources to enhance the training experience. Ensure that training materials comply with organizational standards, workflows, and Epic best practices. End\-User Training: Deliver classroom\-based, virtual, and one\-on\-one training sessions for a wide range of Epic users. Ensure that end\-users are effectively trained on specific Epic modules (such as EpicCare Ambulatory, Inpatient, Willow, ASAP, etc.), focusing on functionality, workflows, and optimization of the system. Facilitate role\-based training for new hires, existing staff, and ongoing Epic upgrades. Training Logistics and Coordination: Coordinate training sessions, including scheduling classes, booking training rooms, and managing attendance. Monitor and track end\-user training progress, ensuring completion of all required training programs before go\-live or system upgrades. Manage and maintain training environments (training versions of the Epic system) to align with real\-world workflows and scenarios. Post\-Go\-Live Support: Provide hands\-on support to users during and after go\-live, offering guidance and troubleshooting assistance as needed. Serve as a key resource for post\-implementation questions and issues, offering continued training support for new features and optimizations. Conduct post\-training evaluations to assess the effectiveness of training and address any knowledge gaps. Collaboration with Epic Teams: Collaborate with Epic application analysts, implementation teams, and subject matter experts to ensure alignment between training content and system configurations. Attend workflow validation and system testing sessions to stay up\-to\-date on system changes that may impact training materials and content. Participate in project team meetings and provide feedback on training needs and challenges related to the Epic system. System Updates and Maintenance: Stay informed about Epic system updates and new releases, revising training materials accordingly to reflect the latest changes and enhancements. Participate in system upgrades and optimization efforts by offering refresher training or additional support for new system features. Continuously improve and update training programs based on user feedback, system changes, and evolving organizational needs. Compliance and Reporting: Ensure that all training programs are aligned with regulatory standards and organizational policies. Track and report training completion and user proficiency to ensure compliance with organizational training requirements. Utilize Epic’s Learning Management System (LMS) or other tools to document and track training attendance and performance.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of experience is required.
* Requires 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Previous experience with EHR systems and workflows, preferably in a training capacity.
* Experience delivering training in a healthcare environment is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design, and training methodologies.
* Proficient in creating training materials, delivering presentations, and managing group learning environments.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, simple, and engaging manner.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple training programs and timelines.
* Proficiency with e\-learning platforms, LMS, and other digital learning tools.
* Ability to adapt training programs based on changing needs, system updates, and feedback.

 **Responsibilities**

**Connect to Promise \-** Demonstrates a commitment to IU Health's mission, vision, and values by exhibiting behaviors and delivering results that align with the strategic direction of the organization. Ensure IU Health is working toward its vision of improving the health of all Hoosiers by providing the best care for each person as we practice our values of purpose, excellence, compassion, and team.

**Training/Education \-** Acts as a preceptor and shares knowledge and expertise to facilitate the learning of others. Develops an education plan or materials for patients, families or staff based on individual learning priorities and evaluates effectiveness of education provided. Makes necessary adjustments based on response to plan.

**Communication \-** Shares thoughts and information in a clear, concise, and professional manner, in both oral and written communication formats. Demonstrates active listening and seeks further information to ensure clarity and understanding. Promptly responds to requests for information while obtaining guidance where needed.

**Ethical Practice \-** Demonstrates the highest level of confidentiality standards in handling of customer relations, medical and prescription records and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) compliance. Maintains confidentiality as appropriate, earns trust and respect of others, and exhibits behaviors that express the ethical practice of a healthcare organization. Demonstrates thorough and logical thought processes to support actions / recommendations. Reports and responds immediately to unethical behavior or conflicts of interest.

**Project Management \-** Implements solutions based on guidelines provided by leadership; appropriately resolves issues within project plan parameters; identifies patterns and potential underlying issues. Provides thoughtful suggestions based on consideration of various pros and cons.

**Problem Solving \-** Proactively and clearly identifies problems or issues and suggests alternative solutions. Uses resources such as other team members, written or online manuals or work\-related materials, etc. to creatively address existing or anticipated work problems. Leverages knowledge and experiences to ensure best practices are being implemented in day\-to\-day work.

**Execution \-** Addresses problems directly and implements objectives effectively. Produces on time high\-quality work deliverables. Apply basic project management principles, and apply logical, consistent, and organized standard of work practices.

**Independent Judgment \-** Exhibits sound professional judgment and diplomacy in handling unexpected problems and frequent interruptions that require immediate action or attention. Escalates issues appropriately in a timely and effective manner.

**Key Relationships**


Reports to: Epic Training Manager

jobs.title: Learning and Development- Field Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Who We Are:
*At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. As a national leader in geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, and materials testing and inspection, we collaborate on transformative projects across transportation, energy, water, healthcare, and more. Learn more about the benefits of joining Team UES and our core values at* *careers.teamues.com**.*
Position Overview:

The Learning and Development\- Field Training Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, coordination, and delivery of training programs across a defined geographic region to support employee performance, operational consistency, and business goals. This role reports to Regional HR Leadership and has a functional reporting relationship to the OD\&T Team. The role partners with HR Staff, Regional leaders, cross\-functional teams, and the OD\&T Team to identify training needs, support the design and development of training content and learning solutions, implement learning initiatives, and ensure team members are equipped with the knowledge, skills, and tools needed to succeed. The ideal candidate is an engaging facilitator, strong communicator, and organized project manager who can adapt training initiatives to meet the needs of diverse audiences.
Responsibilities:  

* Develop, coordinate, and deliver regional training programs for new hires and existing employees.
* Assess training needs in partnership with regional leadership, operations, and other stakeholders.
* Facilitate in\-person, virtual, and hybrid training sessions across multiple locations.
* Create, update, and maintain training materials, job aids, presentations, and learning resources.
* Monitor training effectiveness through evaluations, feedback, participation metrics, and performance outcomes.
* Ensure training content aligns with company policies, procedures, compliance requirements, and operational standards.
* Support onboarding initiatives and role\-specific development programs within the region.
* Partner with subject matter experts to translate business processes into practical learning content.
* Work with OD\&T Team to design, develop, and deliver learning solutions across UES.
* Track training completion, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports for leadership.
* Recommend improvements to training strategies, delivery methods, and learning tools based on regional needs and feedback.
* Serve as a training resource and point of contact for managers and employees across the region.
* Travel within the assigned region to conduct training sessions, support rollouts, and provide field coaching as needed.

  


Job Responsibilities Note:
*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. UES retains the right to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.*Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent field experience will be considered.
* 3\+ years of experience in a training, field technician, or operations support role within engineering, construction, testing, or environmental services.
* Strong knowledge of field procedures, materials testing, inspection processes, and safety practices related to environmental and geotechnical work.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; able to coach and engage learners with varying levels of experience.
* Hands\-on training and facilitation skills; comfortable working in outdoor, active project environments.
* Ability to build trust and credibility with field staff, site supervisors, and project leads.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and familiar with digital tools used for training delivery and reporting
* Willingness to travel frequently (up to 50–75%) to various job sites and regional offices.
* OSHA 10/30 certification or related safety credentials a plus.
Preferred Qualifications:
	+ Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field required.
	+ Certification in training, instructional design, talent development, or facilitation.
	+ Experience developing e\-learning content or blended learning programs.
	+ Familiarity with LMS reporting, training analytics, and performance metrics.
	+ Experience delivering training to adult learners in multiple formats, including in\-person and virtual environments.
	+ Strong presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills.
	+ Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines across a regional territory.
	+ Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
	+ Experience supporting regional or multi\-site operations.
	+ Bilingual communication skills are a plus.
Travel Requirements:
	+ This position requires extensive travel, approximately up to 70% of the time, in support of businessobjectives and client engagements. Travel may be both scheduled and on short notice, depending on
  

project needs. Destinations typically include job sites, field locations, or regional offices, where work may
  

be conducted in outdoor or operational environments. Adherence to all company safety protocols and
  

use of PPE is required during travel and on\-site work.
Physical Demands \& Work Environment:

This position primarily works in an outdoor work environment, regularly exposed to varying field conditions, including:
	+ Sites that may not be accessible by vehicle, requiring travel on foot through wetlands, swamps, grasslands, fields, and other uneven or rugged terrain with natural and man\-made obstacles such as sand, brush, and debris.
	+ Moderate to loud noise levels, common in active construction and industrial environments.
	+ Exposure to environmental elements including dirt, dust, sun, heat, humidity, and adverse weather conditions.
